text: 3 x 400g cans chickpeas drained (or 250g dried chickpeas, soaked in 1 litre cold water overnight, then drained)
1¼ kg potatoes halved or quartered if large
625ml chicken stock made with one stock cube
2 pears peeled, cored and roughly chopped
400g can of chickpeas drained and rinsed
400g Brussels sprout trimmed and thickly sliced
400g self-raising flour plus extra for dusting
400g swede peeled and cut into 2.5cm/1in chunks
1 tsp each mixed spice ground ginger and grated nutmeg
3-4 slices slightly stale white bread crusts removed
cooked couscous or basmati rice, to serve
pinch of ground white pepper plus a pinch extra to serve
½ small pack  coriander stems chopped, leaves reserved
½ tsp chilli flakes or crumble one dried chilli into pieces
small knob   fresh  root ginger finely shredded
1 small courgette diced or cut into long strips approx ½ cm wide
650g side of  salmon skinned and pin-boned, cut crossways into 3cm slices, then cut in half lengthways to get thick fingers
2 limes 1 juiced, 1 cut into wedges to serve
½ small bunch coriander roughly chopped
oil for deep frying, (ideally light olive oil)
olive oil for rubbing and drizzling
900g potatoes peeled and very thinly sliced
5 cardamom pods crushed with a rolling pin
crusty bread or mashed potato, to serve (optional)
½ avocado stoned, peeled and cut into chunks
1 large or 2 medium tart eating  apples
handful each of Thai basil and coriander
500ml rapeseed oil for deep-frying, plus 1 tbsp
slice of  orange and a cherry on a stick
small piece fresh ginger finely chopped
4 slices thick  ham torn into bite-size pieces
1kg potato (King Edward or Maris Piper work well), cut into chunks
3 garlic cloves finely chopped or grated
1medium cauliflower weighing about 500g/1lb 2oz, broken into florets
400g squid cleaned and cut into strips (see tips, below)
1 tbsp olive oil plus more for drizzling
6 pork sausages meat squeezed from the skins
125ml hot  beef stock made with 1 tbsp liquid beef stock (or gluten-free alternative)
200g coarsely grated fresh coconut (about 1 coconut in total)
4 tbsp fresh white breadcrumbs (or put 1 slice crustless white bread through a food processor)
250g assorted sliced cured meats (we used a mixture of salami, garlic sausage and Bayonne ham, but sliced gammon or Parma ham also works well)
2 x 500g packs white marzipan (you'll have trimmings, but better to have leftovers than leave yourself short)
600g  berries (strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries all work well), defrosted if frozen
800g mixed boneless game such as rabbit, venison, wild boar, pheasant, partridge or pigeon, finely chopped
600g cold cooked  chicken (if you are roasting a chicken specially you will need one that weighs about 1.8kg/4lb, or 5-6 boneless breasts, depending on their size)
1 quantity vanilla shortbread dough (see below), with the finely grated zest of 1 lemon added to the flour
1 pre-baked 22cm gluten-free and vegan pastry case or a 400g pack gluten-free, vegan shortcrust pastry, rolled out and baked in a 22cm pie dish following pack instructions
slice wholegrain seeded bread or rye, or wholegrain pitta, to serve
1 garlic bulb, broken into cloves, unpeeled
500g/1lb 2oz pumpkin or squash, peeled, deseeded and cut into large chunks
320g mixed berries (we used blueberries, strawberries and raspberries), halved
350g mixed berry fresh or frozen (we used raspberries, blackberries, redcurrants, blueberries and strawberries)
3 meringues shells, either bought or homemade, broken into large pieces
4 large potatoes (around 500g), 3 peeled and cubed, 1 left whole with skin on
1-2 courgettes (a mix of yellow and green ideally)
2-3 tbsp vegetable oil plus 1 tsp for the marinade
1-2 ripe mangoes peeled, halved and very thinly sliced
½ small pack parsley leaves roughly chopped
few drops peppermint essence or extract
thumb-sized piece of ginger crushed or 1 tbsp ginger purée
1 red or white onion or 4 spring onions, chopped
400g fusilli lunghi or other pasta spirals
red icing or edible red glitter, to decorate (optional)
1kg bone-in Welsh lamb neck or shoulder
45g olive oil or unsalted butter, plus extra for the tray and for shaping
1 tbsp mild olive oil plus extra
coconut ice cream or double cream
